an5.222:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcime bhikkhave ādīnavā dīghacārikaṃ anavattha cārikaṃ anuyuttassa viharato.
an5.222:1.3: anadhigataṃ nādhigacchati adhigataṃ parihāyati, adhigatenekaccena avisārado hoti bāḷhaṃ rogātaṅkaṃ phusati, na ca mittavā hoti.
an5.222:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā dīghacārikaṃ anavattha cārikaṃ anuyuttassa viharato.
an5.222:2.3: anadhigataṃ adhigacchati, adhigataṃ na parihāyati, adhigatenekaccena visārado hoti, na bāḷhaṃ rogātaṅkaṃ phusati, mittavā ca hoti.
an5.222:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ānisaṃsā samavatthacāreti.
